prompts.civic: Use case: illustration-story. Create an isolated reusable illustration for neutral California ballot explainers on a genuinely transparent background. A thoughtful adult voter with a short beard and rolled-sleeve sage shirt stands beside a simple ballot box, holding one plain unmarked paper just above the slot. A modest civic building with steps sits behind and to the right, drawn smaller; no flags or symbols. Ink-and-watercolor artist's sketchbook style with varied charcoal-blue contours, delicate crosshatching, restrained translucent ochre, sage and terracotta washes. Natural anatomy, calm neutral expression, polished editorial illustration. Wide landscape vignette, fully contained with transparent margins, no rectangular backdrop. No text, numbers, logos, parties, checkmarks, or endorsement cues. The artwork will illustrate voting rules and democratic procedures, not a particular vote choice.
prompts.budget: Use case: illustration-story. A reusable isolated ink-and-watercolor editorial vignette about public budgets, on a genuinely transparent background. A calm adult public budget analyst wearing a muted teal cardigan sits at a small wooden desk examining an open ledger and a simple calculator. A small stack of generic coins and two unlettered document folders are on the desk. A simple school building and a modest civic building appear as small background vignettes behind the desk, suggesting public services. No numbers, text, labels, logos, charts, currency symbols, or political endorsements. Professional artist's sketchbook style: varied charcoal-blue ink outlines, delicate crosshatching, translucent granular sage, ochre and terracotta watercolor washes, warm unpainted areas. Natural human proportions, detailed expressive face, balanced neutral mood. Wide composition, all objects fully contained with transparent margins, no rectangular background. Neither glossy 3D nor flat corporate clipart.
